safe_test_strategy: Delegate bounded non-destructive paired probes to the existing SQL injection engine.
expected_behavior: Input must remain data and must not alter query semantics.

potential_false_positives.scenario: Public, cached, reflected or synthetic content resembles a protected result.
potential_false_positives.mitigation: Verify the resource policy, distinct identities, provenance and negative controls before confirming.

confirmation_criteria: Repeatable controlled query-semantic effect; error text alone is insufficient.
impact: Unauthorized query behavior or data disclosure.
